page.notes: The word "Quanquam" in the fourth paragraph and the one in the fifth paragraph are underlined in the print; the underline is not reproduced. Long s is read as s throughout. The note "Summum bonum apud Epicuréos." is set in roman type in the left margin and is split across several lines in the print. The initial "O" is a large woodcut initial, joined to "Omnium" as printed in the scan's first line only as "Mnium"; the opening word is "Omnium". The marginal note's first word is set as "Philosophiç", which I read as "Philosophiæ" with a ligature, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "statur" is the completion of "te-" and is printed at the right below the last line. Italic and roman type in the body are read from the scan and may be imperfect in places.
